title: Resume Objective Tips for 2026
description:
Are resume objectives still relevant in 2026? Or are they quietly killing your chances of landing interviews? In this video, I break down whether you should include a resume objective, the rare cases when it makes sense, and—most importantly—what to write instead: a powerful resume summary that hiring managers and ATS actually care about.
We’ll walk through real examples, a proven formula, and tools to help you rewrite your resume's top section in minutes. If your resume still starts with “Seeking a challenging role…”—this video is for you.
